kOS script

Kerboscript (kOS) subset: SET, LOCK THROTTLE/STEERING, WAIT, WAIT UNTIL, UNTIL, IF/ELSE, WHEN…THEN, FUNCTION/PARAMETER/RETURN, PRINT, STAGE, maneuver nodes (NODE, ADD, NEXTNODE), vectors (V, VANG, VCRS, VXCL), HEADING, PROGRADE/RETROGRADE/UP, SHIP/ORBIT/ETA/BODY/STAGE suffixes, MUN/MINMUS/KERBIN. Flight is 2D (equatorial), so north/normal steering has no effect.
